tasks.title: Setup GitHub Repo
tasks.testStrategy: Verify repository exists and is accessible.

tasks.title: Research, Analysis & Prerequisite Gathering
tasks.description: Analyze workspace, VILA repo, Hugging Face pages, identify components and dependencies. Based on old task02.md.
tasks.details: Performed deep dive into NVLabs/VILA GitHub repo, reviewed Hugging Face pages, identified necessary model components and dependencies. Created initial environment.yml.
tasks.testStrategy: Confirm environment.yml exists and key dependencies are listed.

tasks.title: Model Acquisition & Dataset Preparation
tasks.description: Acquire NVILA-15B model, prepare datasets (including NW & PI), verify environment setup. Based on old 03_model_acquisition_dataset_preparation.md.
tasks.details: Download NVILA-15B, verify components (LLM, tokenizer, vision tower, projector), set up directory structure. Process NW-test-camera-1 and PI-test-camera-1 datasets into VILA format. Install flash-attn, s2wrapper, VILA (editable), apply DeepSpeed patch. Validate model loading and dataset structure.
tasks.testStrategy: Model loads without error. Datasets are in correct format. Environment passes dependency checks.

tasks.title: Define Fine-tuning Strategy
tasks.description: Define hyperparameters, data splitting, training parameters, and evaluation metrics for fine-tuning on CCTV footage.
tasks.details: Determine learning rate, batch size, number of epochs. Decide on validation split strategy (e.g., 80/20 train/val). Choose appropriate evaluation metrics (e.g., perplexity, task-specific accuracy if applicable). Document chosen parameters.
tasks.testStrategy: A configuration file or document exists detailing the full fine-tuning strategy.

tasks.title: Implement Fine-tuning Script
tasks.description: Adapt or create a Python script using the VILA codebase to perform fine-tuning with the defined strategy. Ensure compatibility with local environment and dataset format.
tasks.details: Modify VILA's finetuning scripts (e.g., finetuning/finetune.py) or create a new one. Ensure script correctly loads the model, tokenizer, and datasets. Implement data loading/preprocessing. Integrate defined hyperparameters. Add logging for metrics.
tasks.testStrategy: Script runs without crashing, loads data, and starts a training loop (can be tested with minimal data/epochs initially).

tasks.title: Run Initial Fine-tuning (NW-test-camera-1)
tasks.description: Execute the fine-tuning script using the NW-test-camera-1 dataset. Monitor training progress and log results.
tasks.details: Run the implemented script with the NW-test-camera-1 data and the defined strategy. Ensure sufficient compute resources are available. Monitor training logs for loss reduction and metric improvements. Save checkpoints.
tasks.testStrategy: Training completes for the specified duration. Logs and model checkpoints are saved.

subtasks.title: Configure Fine-tuning Environment for NW-test-camera-1 Dataset
subtasks.description: Set up the computing environment with necessary resources and prepare the NW-test-camera-1 dataset for the fine-tuning process.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Verify GPU/TPU availability and allocate appropriate compute resources for the fine-tuning job
2. Set up environment variables and dependencies required for the fine-tuning script
3. Prepare the NW-test-camera-1 dataset by ensuring it's properly formatted, split (train/validation), and accessible to the training pipeline
4. Configure logging directories for storing training outputs, metrics, and checkpoints
5. Create a configuration file with hyperparameters for the fine-tuning job (learning rate, batch size, epochs, etc.)

Testing approach:
- Verify compute resource allocation with a small test run
- Validate dataset loading with sample batch visualization
- Confirm logging directories are properly created and writable
- Validate configuration file format and parameters

subtasks.title: Execute Fine-tuning Script with Monitoring Setup
subtasks.description: Run the fine-tuning script on the NW-test-camera-1 dataset with real-time monitoring of training metrics and progress.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Launch the fine-tuning script with the configuration from subtask 1
2. Implement real-time monitoring of training metrics (loss, accuracy, etc.) using TensorBoard or similar tool
3. Set up automated checkpoint saving at regular intervals (e.g., every epoch or N steps)
4. Implement early stopping based on validation metrics to prevent overfitting
5. Configure resource monitoring to track GPU/CPU usage, memory consumption during training
6. Set up email or messaging notifications for critical events (training start, completion, or errors)

Testing approach:
- Verify training metrics are being properly logged and visualized
- Confirm checkpoints are being saved correctly at specified intervals
- Test early stopping mechanism with a deliberately simple dataset
- Validate notification system with test alerts

subtasks.title: Analyze Fine-tuning Results and Generate Report
subtasks.description: Evaluate the fine-tuning results, compile performance metrics, and prepare a comprehensive report on the training outcome.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Load the best checkpoint from the saved model checkpoints
2. Evaluate the fine-tuned model on validation data to calculate final performance metrics
3. Generate learning curves showing training/validation loss and metrics over time
4. Compare the fine-tuned model performance against baseline or previous versions
5. Analyze resource utilization during training (compute time, memory usage)
6. Create a comprehensive report with training configuration, results, and key observations
7. Archive the fine-tuned model, configuration, and report for future reference

Testing approach:
- Verify metrics calculation with known test cases
- Validate report generation with sample data
- Ensure model archiving process correctly preserves all necessary artifacts
- Cross-check results with expected performance ranges

tasks.title: Evaluate Fine-tuned Model (NW-test-camera-1, Validation)
tasks.description: Evaluate the performance of the model fine-tuned on NW-test-camera-1. Use appropriate validation techniques (e.g., hold-out set, comparison to base model).
tasks.details: Use the validation split of NW-test-camera-1 (or a separate test set). Calculate defined evaluation metrics. Optionally, perform qualitative analysis by comparing model outputs to base model outputs on sample prompts/images/videos.
tasks.testStrategy: Evaluation metrics are calculated and reported. Comparison against base model (if performed) is documented.

subtasks.title: Prepare Validation Dataset for NW-test-camera-1
subtasks.description: Set up the validation dataset for evaluating the fine-tuned model, ensuring proper data organization and preprocessing.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Load the validation split of NW-test-camera-1 dataset
2. Preprocess the validation data using the same pipeline as used during fine-tuning
3. Organize the data into appropriate batches for evaluation
4. Set up data loaders with appropriate batch size
5. Verify data integrity and format compatibility with the model
6. Document the validation dataset statistics (number of samples, class distribution if applicable)

Testing approach:
- Verify that validation data is loaded correctly by visualizing sample images/videos
- Confirm that preprocessing steps match those used during training
- Check that batch loading works without errors

subtasks.title: Implement Quantitative Evaluation Metrics
subtasks.description: Implement and calculate quantitative evaluation metrics to assess the performance of the fine-tuned model on the validation dataset.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Load the fine-tuned model and the base model for comparison
2. Define relevant evaluation metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, mAP for object detection, BLEU/ROUGE for text generation)
3. Implement a function to run inference on the validation set with both models
4. Calculate all defined metrics for both the fine-tuned and base models
5. Compute confidence intervals for the metrics where applicable
6. Create comparison tables and visualizations of the metrics

Testing approach:
- Verify metric calculations on a small subset with known expected results
- Check that the evaluation pipeline runs end-to-end without errors
- Ensure that metric values are within reasonable ranges

subtasks.title: Perform Qualitative Analysis and Generate Evaluation Report
subtasks.description: Conduct qualitative analysis by comparing outputs from the fine-tuned and base models, and compile a comprehensive evaluation report.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Select a diverse set of representative samples from the validation set
2. Generate outputs from both the fine-tuned and base models for these samples
3. Create side-by-side comparisons of model outputs with ground truth
4. Analyze specific cases where the fine-tuned model performs better or worse than the base model
5. Identify patterns in model performance across different data characteristics
6. Compile a comprehensive report including:
   - Quantitative metrics comparison
   - Qualitative analysis findings
   - Visualizations of sample outputs
   - Recommendations for model improvements
   - Analysis of model strengths and weaknesses

Testing approach:
- Review the sample selection to ensure diversity and representativeness
- Verify that the visualizations clearly show the differences between models
- Have another team member review the report for clarity and completeness

tasks.title: Develop Production System Architecture
tasks.description: Design the high-level architecture for an autonomous system that ingests new data and triggers fine-tuning (even if implementation is deferred).
tasks.details: Diagram the components needed: data ingestion mechanism, storage, trigger for fine-tuning, compute resource allocation, model versioning, serving mechanism. Define interfaces between components.
tasks.testStrategy: An architecture diagram and description document exists.

tasks.title: End-to-End System Testing (PI-test-camera-1)
tasks.description: Perform end-to-end testing of the fine-tuning process using the PI-test-camera-1 dataset to simulate a different camera/scenario.
tasks.details: Repeat the fine-tuning (Task 6) and evaluation (Task 7) process using the PI-test-camera-1 dataset. Compare results to the NW-test-camera-1 run. Identify any dataset-specific issues or necessary adjustments.
tasks.testStrategy: Fine-tuning and evaluation complete successfully for PI-test-camera-1. Results are documented and compared to the first run.
